Body.Content:
Azure Cosmos DB now comes with a desktop data management tooling offered via Azure Storage Explorer. This is a fast, responsive, cross-platform data management experience for Azure Cosmos DB on Mac, Windows, and Linux, consistent with Azure Cosmos DB Portal. It allows users to manage Cosmos DB entities across multiple accounts, manipulate data, update stored procedures, and triggers. 

Learn more
